tables.name: Locations
tables.description:
- **Purpose:** Store all physical installation locations for customers  

- **Key Data:**
  - Link to customer  
  - Location-specific attributes (enriched over time)  

- **Relationship:**
  - One customer → many locations  

- **Scale:**
  - Can contain hundreds of records per customer  

- **Lifecycle:**
  - Data can be enriched before or after installation  

- **Role in system (Operational Endpoint):**
  - Acts as the **central consolidation layer for all operational data**
  - Represents the **end point of the operational lifecycle**, where all execution data converges  

- **Data Consolidation Scope:**
  - **Jobs:**
    - All executed jobs (installation, maintenance, ad hoc)
    - Scheduled future jobs (e.g. preventive maintenance)
  - **Tickets:**
    - Live ticket data with current statuses
  - **Inventory:**
    - Installed assets with status and history
  - **Subscriptions & Contracts:**
    - Active subscriptions linked to installed inventory
    - Contractual context and lifecycle data
  - **Documents & Media:**
    - Job reports
    - Installation images
    - Maintenance images
    - Multi-job historical media trail
  - **Commercial Context:**
    - Quotes and related commercial records  

- **Data Flow Model:**
  - Operational data originates in:
    - Jobs base  
    - Inventory base  
    - Tickets base  
  - Data is **synced and linked back into Locations**
  - Consolidation is achieved with minimal integration complexity:
    - Base syncs across Jobs, Inventory, and Tickets are sufficient  

- **System Role:**
  - Single point of truth for:
    - Operational history  
    - Current system state  
    - Asset deployment  
    - Support activity

tables.name: Customers
tables.description:
- **Purpose:** Core master entity representing a commercial customer  
- **Key Data:**
  - Links to:
    - Country  
    - Brand  
    - Brand Owner  
    - Storefront (optional)  
  - Derived Customer ID (composite)  
- **Customer ID Logic:**
  - Combination of:
    - Country (ISO3 prefix)  
    - Brand  
    - Brand Owner  
    - Storefront (if applicable)  
- **Example:**
  - THA - KFC - CRG  
- **Role in system:**
  - Central reference entity used across all operational bases

- **Role in system:**

tables.name: Arrangements
tables.description:
- **Purpose:** Define display configurations at a location  
- **Key Data:**
  - Installation area (e.g. front-of-house, behind counter)  
  - Orientation (landscape / portrait)  
  - Number of displays  
- **Examples:**
  - 3 or 4 horizontal displays behind a KFC counter  
- **Role in system:**
  - Visual and structural representation of installed display setups  
  - Multiple arrangements can exist per location
